To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a new extension of Mori-Tanaka homogenization method is developed for the viscoplastic composites subjected to stress controlled cyclic loading, which is used in the meso constitutive model to predict the viscoplastic behavior of particle reinforced metal-matrix composites.

a new viscoelastic like meso mechanical model for time dependent cyclic visco plastic behavior of particle reinforced metal composites has been developed and the model is able to predict the cyclic visco plastic deformation of particle reinforced metal composite under the stress controlled conditions.
a cyclic visco plastic mesoscopic constitutive model was developed for time dependent rachetting of particle reinforced composites.

the time dependent ratchetting of particle reinforced metal matrices composites.
